active_problem: Make the completed Step 2B and Step 2C architecture a permanent fail-closed MONSTER execution behavior with hard independent-system isolation.

step2c.first_finding: The completed reliability and autonomous-recovery controls existed but were not owned by a dedicated MONSTER system-level permanence boundary.
step2c.infra_finding: The first remote RED lane stalled before test execution, so it was classified as infrastructure evidence and not treated as a product result.
step2c.architecture_ruling: Use a dedicated MONSTER canonical branch, isolation guard, execution front door, permanent gate, and certification lane rather than extending a shared system boundary.
step2c.first_front_door_failure: The first dedicated front-door run invoked a stale mandatory_2a_global_enforcement_v1 self-test fixture that predates mandatory Step 2B preflight.
step2c.first_front_door_repair: Bind the MONSTER front door to the live enforce_action callable instead of the stale global self-test fixture.
step2c.isolation_audit_finding: The first MONSTER permanent-gate wrapper invoked the broader legacy permanent_gate_v1 validator, which owns unrelated product/domain workflow topology including a main-anchored contract.
step2c.isolation_audit_repair: Do not execute the broader legacy permanent validator. Compose only mandatory_2bc_permanent_enforcement_v1 scoped baseline, MONSTER isolation, MONSTER front door, and the MONSTER-only proof contract.
step2c.second_front_door_failure: Fresh MONSTER certification proved Anti-Loop, Step 2A, Step 2B, Step 2C, integration, and Step 2BC GREEN independently, but the MONSTER front-door self-test still invoked mandatory_2a_action_gate_v1.contract_self_test, whose stale implementation fixture omits the now-mandatory Step 2B preflight.
step2c.second_front_door_root_cause: The front-door self-test was over-coupled to legacy component self-test fixtures. That coupling is not required to prove the front-door boundary and caused a false failure despite the component certification lanes being GREEN.
step2c.second_front_door_repair: Front-door self-test now proves only hard isolation-before-delegation and binding to the live Step 2A execution entrypoint. Anti-Loop, Step 2A, Step 2B, Step 2C, and their integrations remain independently certified by the MONSTER workflow.
